description: This file defines the 'BinaryProtocol' class which handles communication with a device using a custom binary protocol. It includes methods for connecting to the device, switching protocols, reading and writing configuration images, sending commands, and processing responses. The class also manages data buffers, CRC checks, and external dependencies to facilitate device communication and firmware updates.

classes.name: BinaryProtocol
classes.description: Handles communication with hardware device through a binary protocol, including reading/writing config, protocol switching, and command execution.

methods.name: connectAndReadConfiguration
methods.description: Switches device to binary protocol and reads its configuration snapshot.

methods.name: switchToBinaryProtocol
methods.description: Attempts to switch the device communication protocol to binary mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the communication stream and marks the protocol as closed.

methods.name: uploadChanges
methods.description: Uploads modifications to the device configuration image.

methods.name: readImage
methods.description: Reads the entire configuration image from the device.

methods.name: setController
methods.description: Sets the current configuration image in the protocol handler.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns a clone of the current configuration image.
